label: Office
blurb: Excel, Word and PowerPoint files. Inspect, edit in place, verify, hand back.
_note: Same seven built-ins as `patch`, on purpose — an .xlsx is edited by writing a Python script and running it, which is read/write/edit plus bash. The harness is not defined by its tools here but by its SYSTEM.md, and that is the point: the destructive moves (edit the binary directly, convert to csv and back, save a data_only workbook) all happen on the FIRST turn, before a model would think to load a skill. Discipline that has to be resident is what a mode is for.

The API recipes are NOT resident: they live in skills/office-files/, so the standing cost is the skill's name and description, and the 6 KB of openpyxl/python-docx detail loads only when an edit actually starts.

No library is installed on the machine and none needs to be — `uv run --with openpyxl --with python-docx --with python-pptx` fetches into a cached throwaway env (verified 2026-08-11: openpyxl 3.1.5 under Python 3.14). LibreOffice 26.2 (`soffice`) and pandoc 3.10 are present for legacy .xls/.doc and for PDF export.

Traps in SYSTEM.md are measured, not folklore (2026-08-11): loading with data_only=True and saving turned `=SUM(B2:B4)` into None with no error; a csv-shaped round-trip lost 5 archive parts (chart, drawings, sheet rels) and the second sheet; python-docx split `项目预算为 1,200 万元` into three runs, so a per-run search for the number misses it.
engine is pi, not omp. Nothing in this work needs a browser or LSP, and omp's 8.1k-token floor with --no-tools is above this whole harness's price.
